How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

    I HATE bad optics. Looking through cheap sunglasses drives me insane. I have tried many brands over the years but always seem to return to Ray-Ban for the lens color. Turns out they have it patented. For me the only other brand that even comes close is Randolph aviation products.

    I am very happy with the Ray-Bans. They fit nicely in my full face helmet and the lower wire frame does not occlude my vision, very important on a motorbike.

    As cool as they look I have not been attacked by any women yet. This is a fault of my not looking like Brad Pitt.

Product Description

Born in the ‘80s and donned by inspirational thinkers and visionaries ever since. The Clubmaster became an icon of the club scene (hence the name) before returning to set new standards with the rise of retro and hipster subculture in 2010. The RB3016 Clubmaster sunglasses are both retro and timeless. Inspired by the 50s, the instantly recognizable style is worn by cultural intellectuals and leaders. Available in a variety of frame and lens combinations, from black on gold and blue on silver frames to polarized, solid, and mirrored lenses. Ray-Ban sunglasses sold by authorized sellers, like Amazon, are eligible for all manufacturer warranties and guarantees. Click on the Ray-Ban link above the product title to shop the entire Ray-Ban sunglass and eyeglass assortment.
